description: For one school, every measure of the CourseShelf measure register (enrollment and access, ways in, policy, applicability and progress, programs and the market, community, the new era), for the school and for its peers, each a value with its source and date or the status where the data chain breaks: Inferred, Not captured, Captured, wrong page, Captured, not harvested, Harvested, not served, Not inferred, Not held; never 0 for something missing. Peers by WO-V1118-01's method (same control and level, same Carnegie size and setting, in the same state or, where none there meets them, nationwide, ranked by program families shared), each with its basis; where no school meets them, the answer says why. A gap names its break: Captured, wrong page where every capture of the area is a page about something else, and for Not captured the page known to exist where the school's own pages link to it. Ends with what to fix for the school, by owner: Gather, Harvest, Serve, inference. Read-only. Answered to every caller.
name: measure_register
title: CourseShelf Measure Register
